package com.example.aas.network;

import com.example.aas.block.HubBlockEntity;
import com.example.aas.item.AGSAmmoItem;
import com.example.aas.item.M2AmmoItem;
import com.example.aas.item.ModItems;
import net.minecraft.ChatFormatting;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.network.FriendlyByteBuf;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Items;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraftforge.network.NetworkEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.registries.ForgeRegistries;

import java.util.function.Supplier;

public class PacketRequestAmmo {
    private final BlockPos pos;
    private final int type;
    // 0 = Basic Ammo (Placeholder)
    // 1 = AGS (20 mats, 60s)
    // 2 = M2 (15 mats, 60s)
    // 3 = Mortar (20 mats, 120s) -> 8 shells
    // 4 = TOW (50 mats, 120s) -> 2 missiles

    public PacketRequestAmmo(BlockPos pos, int type) {
        this.pos = pos;
        this.type = type;
    }

    public static void encode(PacketRequestAmmo msg, FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        buf.writeBlockPos(msg.pos);
        buf.writeInt(msg.type);
    }

    public static PacketRequestAmmo decode(FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        return new PacketRequestAmmo(buf.readBlockPos(), buf.readInt());
    }

    public static void handle(PacketRequestAmmo msg, Supplier<NetworkEvent.Context> ctx) {
        ctx.get().enqueueWork(() -> {
            ServerPlayer player = ctx.get().getSender();
            if (player == null) return;
            if (player.distanceToSqr(msg.pos.getX(), msg.pos.getY(), msg.pos.getZ()) > 64.0) return;

            BlockEntity be = player.level().getBlockEntity(msg.pos);
            if (be instanceof HubBlockEntity hub) {

                int cost = 0;
                int cooldownTime = 0;
                boolean isOnCooldown = false;

                // РќР°СЃС‚СЂР°РёРІР°РµРј РїР°СЂР°РјРµС‚СЂС‹ РІ Р·Р°РІРёСЃРёРјРѕСЃС‚Рё РѕС‚ С‚РёРїР°
                switch (msg.type) {
                    case 0: // Placeholder
                        player.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal("Basic Ammo not implemented yet.").withStyle(ChatFormatting.YELLOW));
                        return;
                    case 1: // AGS
                        cost = 20;
                        cooldownTime = 1200; // 60s
                        if (hub.cooldownAGS > 0) isOnCooldown = true;
                        break;
                    case 2: // M2
                        cost = 15;
                        cooldownTime = 1200; // 60s
                        if (hub.cooldownM2 > 0) isOnCooldown = true;
                        break;
                    case 3: // Mortar
                        cost = 20;
                        cooldownTime = 2400; // 120s
                        if (hub.cooldownMortar > 0) isOnCooldown = true;
                        break;
                    case 4: // TOW
                        cost = 50;
                        cooldownTime = 2400; // 120s
                        if (hub.cooldownTOW > 0) isOnCooldown = true;
                        break;
                }

                // РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂРєР° РљР” (РґР»СЏ РІС‹Р¶РёРІР°РЅРёСЏ)
                if (!player.isCreative() && isOnCooldown) {
                    player.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal("Supply on Cooldown!").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED));
                    return;
                }

                // РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂРєР° РјР°С‚РµСЂРёР°Р»РѕРІ (РґР»СЏ РІС‹Р¶РёРІР°РЅРёСЏ)
                if (!player.isCreative() && hub.getMaterials() < cost) {
                    player.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal("Not enough Construction Materials! Need: " + cost).withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED));
                    return;
                }

                // === Р’Р«Р”РђР§Рђ РџР Р•Р”РњР•РўРћР’ ===
                boolean success = false;

                if (msg.type == 1) { // AGS Box
                    ItemStack stack = new ItemStack(ModItems.AGS_AMMO.get());
                    AGSAmmoItem.setAmmo(stack, AGSAmmoItem.MAX_AMMO);
                    if (player.getInventory().add(stack)) success = true;
                    else player.drop(stack, false);
                    success = true;
                }
                else if (msg.type == 2) { // M2 Box
                    ItemStack stack = new ItemStack(ModItems.M2_AMMO.get());
                    M2AmmoItem.setAmmo(stack, M2AmmoItem.MAX_AMMO);
                    if (player.getInventory().add(stack)) success = true;
                    else player.drop(stack, false);
                    success = true;
                }
                else if (msg.type == 3) { // MORTAR (8 shells)
                    Item mortarItem = ForgeRegistries.ITEMS.getValue(new ResourceLocation("superbwarfare", "mortar_shell"));
                    // Р•СЃР»Рё РјРѕРґР° РЅРµС‚ РёР»Рё РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РЅРµС‚, РІС‹РґР°РµРј СЃС‚СЂРµР»С‹
                    if (mortarItem == null || mortarItem == Items.AIR) mortarItem = Items.ARROW;

                    ItemStack stack = new ItemStack(mortarItem, 8);
                    if (player.getInventory().add(stack)) success = true;
                    else player.drop(stack, false);
                    success = true;
                }
                else if (msg.type == 4) { // TOW (2 missiles)
                    Item towItem = ForgeRegistries.ITEMS.getValue(new ResourceLocation("superbwarfare", "medium_anti_ground_missile"));
                    // Р•СЃР»Рё РјРѕРґР° РЅРµС‚, РІС‹РґР°РµРј СЃРїРµРєС‚СЂР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рµ СЃС‚СЂРµР»С‹
                    if (towItem == null || towItem == Items.AIR) towItem = Items.SPECTRAL_ARROW;

                    ItemStack stack = new ItemStack(towItem, 2);
                    if (player.getInventory().add(stack)) success = true;
                    else player.drop(stack, false);
                    success = true;
                }

                // === РЎРџРРЎРђРќРР• Р РљРЈР›Р”РђРЈРќ ===
                if (success) {
                    if (!player.isCreative()) {
                        hub.consumeMaterials(cost);
                        hub.setCooldown(msg.type, cooldownTime);
                    }
                    player.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal("Resupplied! (-" + cost + " Mats)").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN));

                    // РћР±РЅРѕРІР»СЏРµРј Р±Р»РѕРє, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РІСЃРµ РёРіСЂРѕРєРё РІРёРґРµР»Рё РЅРѕРІС‹Рµ РјР°С‚РµСЂРёР°Р»С‹ Рё РљР”
                    player.level().sendBlockUpdated(msg.pos, hub.getBlockState(), hub.getBlockState(), 3);
                }
            }
        });
        ctx.get().setPacketHandled(true);
    }
}


===== ФАЙЛ: PacketRespawnRequest.java =====
package com.example.aas.network;

import com.example.aas.block.RallyPointBlock;
import com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.network.FriendlyByteBuf;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.level.GameType;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;
import net.minecraftforge.network.NetworkEvent;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Supplier;

public class PacketRespawnRequest {
    private final String type;

    public PacketRespawnRequest(String type) {
        this.type = type;
    }

    public static void encode(PacketRespawnRequest msg, FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        buf.writeUtf(msg.type);
    }

    public static PacketRespawnRequest decode(FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        return new PacketRespawnRequest(buf.readUtf());
    }

    public static void handle(PacketRespawnRequest msg, Supplier<NetworkEvent.Context> ctx) {
        ctx.get().enqueueWork(() -> {
            ServerPlayer player = ctx.get().getSender();
            if (player == null || (player.isAlive() && player.getHealth() > 0)) return;

            AASWorldData data = AASWorldData.get(player.serverLevel().getServer().overworld());
            BlockPos targetPos = null;

            if (player.getTeam() != null) {
                String team = player.getTeam().getName();
                boolean isBlue = team.equalsIgnoreCase("Blue");

                if (msg.type.equals("MAIN")) {
                    targetPos = isBlue ? data.blueSpawn : data.redSpawn;
                }
                else if (msg.type.equals("RALLY")) {
                    List<BlockPos> rallies = isBlue ? data.blueRallies : data.redRallies;
                    List<BlockPos> checkList = new ArrayList<>(rallies);
                    Collections.reverse(checkList);

                    for (BlockPos rallyPos : checkList) {
                        BlockState state = player.serverLevel().getBlockState(rallyPos);
                        if (state.getBlock() instanceof RallyPointBlock) {

                            // === Р¤РРќРђР›Р¬РќРђРЇ РџР РћР’Р•Р РљРђ РќРђ Р’Р РђР“РћР’ ===
                            if (isEnemyNearby(player.serverLevel(), rallyPos, team)) {
                                player.sendSystemMessage(Component.literal("Rally Point is BLOCKED by enemies!").withStyle(net.minecraft.ChatFormatting.RED));
                                break; // Р Р°Р»РёРє РµСЃС‚СЊ, РЅРѕ РѕРЅ Р·Р°Р±Р»РѕРєРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅ. РЎРїР°РІРЅ РЅРµРІРѕР·РјРѕР¶РµРЅ.
                            }

                            targetPos = rallyPos;
                            break;
                        }
                    }

                    if (targetPos == null) {
                        // Р•СЃР»Рё Р·Р°Р±Р»РѕРєРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅ РёР»Рё РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ -> РЅР° РњРµР№РЅ
                        targetPos = isBlue ? data.blueSpawn : data.redSpawn;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (targetPos == null) targetPos = player.serverLevel().getSharedSpawnPos();

            player.setRespawnPosition(player.serverLevel().dimension(), targetPos, 0.0f, true, false);
            if (player.gameMode.getGameModeForPlayer() == GameType.SPECTATOR) {
                player.setGameMode(GameType.SURVIVAL);
            }
        });
        ctx.get().setPacketHandled(true);
    }

    private static boolean isEnemyNearby(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos, String allyTeamName) {
        AABB checkArea = new AABB(pos).inflate(40);
        List<ServerPlayer> enemies = level.getEntitiesOfClass(ServerPlayer.class, checkArea);
        for (ServerPlayer p : enemies) {
            if (p.isSpectator()) continue;
            if (p.getTeam() != null && !p.getTeam().getName().equalsIgnoreCase(allyTeamName)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

package com.example.aas.network;
import com.example.aas.client.ClientHooks;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.network.FriendlyByteBuf;
import net.minecraftforge.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.minecraftforge.fml.DistExecutor;
import net.minecraftforge.network.NetworkEvent;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
public class PacketSyncGameData {
    public final int blueTickets;
    public final int redTickets;
    public final boolean hasBlueRally;
    public final boolean hasRedRally;
    public final boolean blueBleeding;
    public final boolean redBleeding;
    public final int respawnTime;
    public final boolean blueBlocked;
    public final boolean redBlocked;
    public final List<BlockPos> hubs;
    public final String blueFaction;
    public final String redFaction;
    public final boolean isGameStarted; // === РќРћР’РћР• РџРћР›Р• ===

    public PacketSyncGameData(int blue, int red, boolean hasBlue, boolean hasRed,
                              boolean blueBleed, boolean redBleed, int rTime,
                              boolean bBlocked, boolean rBlocked, List<BlockPos> hubs,
                              String bFac, String rFac, boolean isGameStarted) {
        this.blueTickets = blue;
        this.redTickets = red;
        this.hasBlueRally = hasBlue;
        this.hasRedRally = hasRed;
        this.blueBleeding = blueBleed;
        this.redBleeding = redBleed;
        this.respawnTime = rTime;
        this.blueBlocked = bBlocked;
        this.redBlocked = rBlocked;
        this.hubs = hubs;
        this.blueFaction = bFac;
        this.redFaction = rFac;
        this.isGameStarted = isGameStarted;
    }

    public static void encode(PacketSyncGameData msg, FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        buf.writeInt(msg.blueTickets);
        buf.writeInt(msg.redTickets);
        buf.writeBoolean(msg.hasBlueRally);
        buf.writeBoolean(msg.hasRedRally);
        buf.writeBoolean(msg.blueBleeding);
        buf.writeBoolean(msg.redBleeding);
        buf.writeInt(msg.respawnTime);
        buf.writeBoolean(msg.blueBlocked);
        buf.writeBoolean(msg.redBlocked);
        buf.writeCollection(msg.hubs, FriendlyByteBuf::writeBlockPos);
        buf.writeUtf(msg.blueFaction);
        buf.writeUtf(msg.redFaction);
        buf.writeBoolean(msg.isGameStarted); // РџРёС€РµРј
    }

    public static PacketSyncGameData decode(FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        int blue = buf.readInt();
        int red = buf.readInt();
        boolean hasBlue = buf.readBoolean();
        boolean hasRed = buf.readBoolean();
        boolean blueBleed = buf.readBoolean();
        boolean redBleed = buf.readBoolean();
        int rTime = buf.readInt();
        boolean bBlocked = buf.readBoolean();
        boolean rBlocked = buf.readBoolean();
        List<BlockPos> hubsList = buf.readList(FriendlyByteBuf::readBlockPos);
        String bFac = buf.readUtf();
        String rFac = buf.readUtf();
        boolean isGameStarted = buf.readBoolean(); // Р§РёС‚Р°РµРј

        return new PacketSyncGameData(blue, red, hasBlue, hasRed, blueBleed, redBleed, rTime, bBlocked, rBlocked, hubsList, bFac, rFac, isGameStarted);
    }

    public static void handle(PacketSyncGameData msg, Supplier<NetworkEvent.Context> ctx) {
        ctx.get().enqueueWork(() -> {
            DistExecutor.unsafeRunWhenOn(Dist.CLIENT, () -> () -> ClientHooks.handleSyncGameData(msg));
        });
        ctx.get().setPacketHandled(true);
    }
}

public class PacketSyncPoint {

    public final String owner;
    public final float progress;

    public final String nextObjective;
    public final boolean isContested;
    // РќРћР’РћР• РџРћР›Р•

    public PacketSyncPoint(boolean isInside, String name, String owner, float progress, boolean locked, String nextObj, boolean contested, String capturingTeam) {

        this.name = name;
        this.owner = owner;
        this.progress = progress;
        this.isLocked = locked;
        this.nextObjective = nextObj;

        buf.writeFloat(msg.progress);
        buf.writeBoolean(msg.isLocked);
        buf.writeUtf(msg.nextObjective);

                buf.readFloat(),

package com.example.aas.network;

import com.example.aas.entity.AGS30Entity;
import com.example.aas.entity.M2BrowningEntity;
import net.minecraft.network.FriendlyByteBuf;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraftforge.network.NetworkEvent;

import java.util.function.Supplier;

public class PacketToggleAim {
    public PacketToggleAim() {}

    public static void encode(PacketToggleAim msg, FriendlyByteBuf buf) {}

    public static PacketToggleAim decode(FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        return new PacketToggleAim();
    }

    public static void handle(PacketToggleAim msg, Supplier<NetworkEvent.Context> ctx) {
        ctx.get().enqueueWork(() -> {
            ServerPlayer player = ctx.get().getSender();
            if (player != null) {
                Entity vehicle = player.getVehicle();

                // M2 Browning
                if (vehicle instanceof M2BrowningEntity m2) {
                    m2.setAiming(!m2.isAiming());
                }

                // === РР—РњР•РќР•РќРР• 8: РћР±СЂР°Р±РѕС‚РєР° AGS-30 ===
                else if (vehicle instanceof AGS30Entity ags) {
                    ags.setAiming(!ags.isAiming());
                }
            }
        });
        ctx.get().setPacketHandled(true);
    }
}


===== ФАЙЛ: PacketUpdateSpawner.java =====
package com.example.aas.network;

import com.example.aas.block.VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.network.FriendlyByteBuf;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraftforge.network.NetworkEvent;

import java.util.function.Supplier;

public class PacketUpdateSpawner {
    private final BlockPos pos;
    private final int respawnTime;
    private final int initialTime;
    private final String vehicleId; // РџРµСЂРµРґР°РµРј ID С‚РµС…РЅРёРєРё

    public PacketUpdateSpawner(BlockPos pos, int respawn, int init, String id) {
        this.pos = pos;
        this.respawnTime = respawn;
        this.initialTime = init;
        this.vehicleId = id;
    }

    public static void encode(PacketUpdateSpawner msg, FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        buf.writeBlockPos(msg.pos);
        buf.writeInt(msg.respawnTime);
        buf.writeInt(msg.initialTime);
        buf.writeUtf(msg.vehicleId); // РџРёС€РµРј СЃС‚СЂРѕРєСѓ
    }

    public static PacketUpdateSpawner decode(FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        return new PacketUpdateSpawner(buf.readBlockPos(), buf.readInt(), buf.readInt(), buf.readUtf());
    }

    public static void handle(PacketUpdateSpawner msg, Supplier<NetworkEvent.Context> ctx) {
        ctx.get().enqueueWork(() -> {
            ServerPlayer player = ctx.get().getSender();
            if (player != null && player.isCreative()) {
                BlockEntity be = player.level().getBlockEntity(msg.pos);
                if (be instanceof VehicleSpawnerBlockEntity spawner) {
                    spawner.respawnTimeSettings = msg.respawnTime;
                    spawner.initialTimeSettings = msg.initialTime;
                    spawner.vehicleIdString = msg.vehicleId; // РћР±РЅРѕРІР»СЏРµРј ID
                    spawner.setChanged();
                    player.level().sendBlockUpdated(msg.pos, spawner.getBlockState(), spawner.getBlockState(), 3);
                }
            }
        });
        ctx.get().setPacketHandled(true);
    }
}

                    ags.tryShoot(player);
                }

package com.example.aas.sound;

import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent;
import net.minecraftforge.eventbus.api.IEventBus;
import net.minecraftforge.registries.DeferredRegister;
import net.minecraftforge.registries.ForgeRegistries;
import net.minecraftforge.registries.RegistryObject;

public class ModSounds {
    public static final DeferredRegister<SoundEvent> SOUND_EVENTS =
            DeferredRegister.create(ForgeRegistries.SOUND_EVENTS, "aas");

    public static final RegistryObject<SoundEvent> HUB_IDLE = registerSoundEvent("hub_idle");
    public static final RegistryObject<SoundEvent> M2_LOAD = registerSoundEvent("m2_load");
    public static final RegistryObject<SoundEvent> M2_UNLOAD = registerSoundEvent("m2_unload");

    // === Р”РћР‘РђР’Р›РЇР•Рњ Р—Р’РЈРљ Р’Р«РЎРўР Р•Р›Рђ AGS ===
    public static final RegistryObject<SoundEvent> AGS_SHOOT = registerSoundEvent("ags_shoot");

    // Р”РћР‘РђР’Р›РЇР•Рњ Р­РўРЈ РЎРўР РћРљРЈ:
    public static final RegistryObject<SoundEvent> M2_SHOOT = registerSoundEvent("m2_shoot");

    private static RegistryObject<SoundEvent> registerSoundEvent(String name) {
        ResourceLocation id = new ResourceLocation("aas", name);
        return SOUND_EVENTS.register(name, () -> SoundEvent.createVariableRangeEvent(id));
    }

    public static void register(IEventBus eventBus) {
        SOUND_EVENTS.register(eventBus);
    }
}


===== ФАЙЛ: AASWorldData.java =====
package com.example.aas.world;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.ListTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.LongTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.Tag;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.saveddata.SavedData;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
public class AASWorldData extends SavedData {
    public List<CapturePoint> capturePoints = new ArrayList<>();
    public List<BlockPos> blueRallies = new ArrayList<>();
    public List<BlockPos> redRallies = new ArrayList<>();
    public List<BlockPos> hubs = new ArrayList<>();

    public BlockPos blueSpawn = null;
    public BlockPos redSpawn = null;
    public int blueTickets = 800;
    public int redTickets = 800;
    public int respawnTimer = 10;
    public int deathTicketCost = 2;

    public String blueFaction = "none";
    public String redFaction = "none";

    // === РќРћР’РћР• РџРћР›Р• ===
    public boolean isGameStarted = false;

    @Override
    public CompoundTag save(CompoundTag tag) {
        tag.putInt("BlueTickets", blueTickets);
        tag.putInt("RedTickets", redTickets);
        tag.putInt("RespawnTimer", respawnTimer);
        tag.putInt("DeathTicketCost", deathTicketCost);
        tag.putString("BlueFaction", blueFaction);
        tag.putString("RedFaction", redFaction);
        tag.putBoolean("IsGameStarted", isGameStarted); // РЎРѕС…СЂР°РЅСЏРµРј

        ListTag blueList = new ListTag();
        for (BlockPos pos : blueRallies) blueList.add(LongTag.valueOf(pos.asLong()));
        tag.put("BlueRallies", blueList);

        ListTag redList = new ListTag();
        for (BlockPos pos : redRallies) redList.add(LongTag.valueOf(pos.asLong()));
        tag.put("RedRallies", redList);

        ListTag hubList = new ListTag();
        for (BlockPos pos : hubs) hubList.add(LongTag.valueOf(pos.asLong()));
        tag.put("Hubs", hubList);

        if (blueSpawn != null) tag.putLong("BlueSpawn", blueSpawn.asLong());
        if (redSpawn != null) tag.putLong("RedSpawn", redSpawn.asLong());

        ListTag pointsList = new ListTag();
        for (CapturePoint point : capturePoints) {
            pointsList.add(point.save());
        }
        tag.put("CapturePoints", pointsList);

        return tag;
    }

    public static AASWorldData load(CompoundTag tag) {
        AASWorldData data = new AASWorldData();

        if (tag.contains("BlueTickets")) data.blueTickets = tag.getInt("BlueTickets");
        if (tag.contains("RedTickets")) data.redTickets = tag.getInt("RedTickets");
        if (tag.contains("RespawnTimer")) data.respawnTimer = tag.getInt("RespawnTimer");
        if (tag.contains("DeathTicketCost")) data.deathTicketCost = tag.getInt("DeathTicketCost");
        if (tag.contains("BlueFaction")) data.blueFaction = tag.getString("BlueFaction");
        if (tag.contains("RedFaction")) data.redFaction = tag.getString("RedFaction");
        if (tag.contains("IsGameStarted")) data.isGameStarted = tag.getBoolean("IsGameStarted"); // Р—Р°РіСЂСѓР¶Р°РµРј

        if (tag.contains("BlueRallies")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("BlueRallies", Tag.TAG_LONG);
            for (Tag t : list) data.blueRallies.add(BlockPos.of(((LongTag) t).getAsLong()));
        }
        if (tag.contains("RedRallies")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("RedRallies", Tag.TAG_LONG);
            for (Tag t : list) data.redRallies.add(BlockPos.of(((LongTag) t).getAsLong()));
        }
        if (tag.contains("Hubs")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("Hubs", Tag.TAG_LONG);
            for (Tag t : list) data.hubs.add(BlockPos.of(((LongTag) t).getAsLong()));
        }

        if (tag.contains("BlueSpawn")) data.blueSpawn = BlockPos.of(tag.getLong("BlueSpawn"));
        if (tag.contains("RedSpawn")) data.redSpawn = BlockPos.of(tag.getLong("RedSpawn"));

        if (tag.contains("CapturePoints")) {
            ListTag list = tag.getList("CapturePoints", Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
                data.capturePoints.add(CapturePoint.load(list.getCompound(i)));
            }
        }

        return data;
    }

    public static AASWorldData get(ServerLevel level) {
        return level.getDataStorage().computeIfAbsent(AASWorldData::load, AASWorldData::new, "aas_world_data");
    }

    public static class CapturePoint {
        public String name;
        public AABB area;
        public int bluePriority;
        public int redPriority;
        public int captureTimeMinutes;
        public int ticketPenalty;
        public int captureDeduction;
        public String owner = "NEUTRAL";
        public float progress = 0.0f;
        public String capturingTeam = "NONE";

        public CapturePoint(String name, AABB area, int bp, int rp, int time, int penalty, int deduct) {
            this.name = name; this.area = area; this.bluePriority = bp; this.redPriority = rp;
            this.captureTimeMinutes = time; this.ticketPenalty = penalty; this.captureDeduction = deduct;
        }

        public CompoundTag save() {
            CompoundTag tag = new CompoundTag();
            tag.putString("Name", name);
            tag.putDouble("minX", area.minX); tag.putDouble("minY", area.minY); tag.putDouble("minZ", area.minZ);
            tag.putDouble("maxX", area.maxX); tag.putDouble("maxY", area.maxY); tag.putDouble("maxZ", area.maxZ);
            tag.putInt("BluePriority", bluePriority);
            tag.putInt("RedPriority", redPriority);
            tag.putInt("Time", captureTimeMinutes);
            tag.putInt("Penalty", ticketPenalty);
            tag.putInt("Deduct", captureDeduction);
            tag.putString("Owner", owner);
            tag.putFloat("Progress", progress);
            tag.putString("CapturingTeam", capturingTeam);
            return tag;
        }

        public static CapturePoint load(CompoundTag tag) {
            String name = tag.getString("Name");
            AABB area = new AABB(
                    tag.getDouble("minX"), tag.getDouble("minY"), tag.getDouble("minZ"),
                    tag.getDouble("maxX"), tag.getDouble("maxY"), tag.getDouble("maxZ")
            );
            int bp = tag.getInt("BluePriority");
            int rp = tag.getInt("RedPriority");
            int time = tag.getInt("Time");
            int penalty = tag.getInt("Penalty");
            int deduct = tag.contains("Deduct") ? tag.getInt("Deduct") : 0;

            CapturePoint point = new CapturePoint(name, area, bp, rp, time, penalty, deduct);
            if (tag.contains("Owner")) point.owner = tag.getString("Owner");
            if (tag.contains("Progress")) point.progress = tag.getFloat("Progress");
            if (tag.contains("CapturingTeam")) point.capturingTeam = tag.getString("CapturingTeam");

            return point;
        }
    }
}
